assumptions.householdToIndividual: use the official wealth-decile × income-decile household-count matrix and same-year income-quintile household sizes to estimate the average household size of each wealth decile; convert each wealth threshold with the adjacent wealth-decile household-size estimates and convert household counts to estimated people, then normalize to the fixed all-Taiwan population
assumptions.quintileMeanCalibration: convert each wealth quintile mean using the weighted household-size estimate for the corresponding two wealth deciles; calibrate lower and middle within-band shapes to those converted means
assumptions.lowerTail: retain negative net worth with a reverse-exponential lower tail calibrated to the first converted wealth-quintile mean
assumptions.topTail: retain the official D5-D9 survival fit as a diagnostic, then use a piecewise Pareto upper tail that preserves the converted top-quintile mean and connects to the Forbes top-50 cutoff and largest individual-equivalent Forbes anchor
assumptions.forbesFamilySplit: when a Forbes entry explicitly lists multiple named relatives, split the listed fortune equally only to derive individual-equivalent tail diagnostics/top anchor; the 50-entry cutoff remains an entry-count anchor
assumptions.peopleBeaten: strictly lower net worth than the queried amount
